items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve and signed RB Jaleel McLaughlin to active roster from practice squad.
items.why: Knee injury leads to IR (min 4 games).
items.implication: Judkins/Sanders committee solidifies; Sanders waiver stash.

items.text: A.J. Brown high ankle sprain leads to IR; expected 4-6 weeks. Beneficiaries Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas per ETR waiver notes.
items.why: High ankle confirmed, IR placement min 4 games, reports up to 6 weeks.
items.implication: Doubs/Douglas elevated for Maye; waiver priority on NE WRs.

items.text: ETR Week 2 injury beneficiaries for waivers: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders; A.J. Brown=Doubs/Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel.
items.why: Precise next-man-up mapping from early injury report for FAAB/priority claims.
items.implication: Target these stashes/streamers immediately; FAAB guidance included.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has a legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per reports. Same left knee that had PCL sprain and bone bruise last season—scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim with realistic one-game miss chance, but prior knee issues raise caution.
items.implication: Monitor practice; if active could be immediate TE1, else Mayer continues.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team will see how he feels this week before determining Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; Harbaugh DTD, monitored all week.
items.implication: If out, Tre Harris and others elevate; check Wednesday practice.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid 49ers WR injury fallout (Stribling).
items.why: Berry highlights as priority add on FFHH; ETR lists as Stribling beneficiary.
items.implication: Strong WR3/Flex add with expanded role potential.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) listed in ETR injury report as out/elevating Kendre Miller for waivers/streaming.
items.why: Knee issue keeps him out; Miller clear beneficiary in committee.
items.implication: Miller RB flex/handcuff add; Etienne still lead but shared.
items.opportunity: Miller snaps/routes/opps rose in W1 absence

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9 yards, just 2.5 last night with only 2 targets (7% share). Routes were strong though: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30). Needs serious volume to pay off.
items.why: High routes but tiny aDOT and low target share in return; volume-dependent.
items.implication: Monitor target share closely; efficient but needs more looks for WR2 upside.
items.opportunity: 29 routes on 33 dropbacks but only 2 targets

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in KC debut, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 receiving. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, high route/target share in debut with Mahomes.
items.implication: Elite RB1 usage locked in; start every week with workhorse confidence.
items.opportunity: 29/32 RB opps, 19 routes, 6 targets, goal-line implied

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early. Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Low route involvement despite backup injury; split with Sanders.
items.implication: Judkins more pure rusher; limited PPR floor. Sanders stash post-Sampson IR.

items.text: With Alvin Kamara (knee) out, Travis Etienne didn't fully dominate: snaps 53 (Miller 26, Donaldson 15), routes 24/7/5, opportunities 18/9/4. Committee remains.
items.why: Etienne led but shared more than expected even without Kamara.
items.implication: Etienne RB2 with upside but Miller handcuff/beneficiary if Kamara limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game since ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), team-high 9 targets 31% share, 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Solid snap/route/target share in return from major knee injury; looked healthy.
items.implication: WR1 upside back; start confidently as volume leader.

items.text: Xavier Worthy led KC Week 1 with 22.2% target share and 30% first-read share (per FantasyPtsData).
items.why: Led team in target and first-read share alongside Walker explosion.
items.implication: WR2/3 with deep threat + volume; pairs with Rice routes.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). Sole RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Looked healthy; strong vs CLE.
items.why: Goal-line monopoly and route edge over Gainwell despite modest carries.
items.implication: RB2/Flex with receiving upside; healthy and role secure.
items.opportunity: Only GL carry, 21 routes vs Gainwell 13, 7 targets
